generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)
The contractor should submit quality control reports, material test reports and photos along with the bill otherwise bills will not be accepted.
The work will be inspected by the Third party and the bill will be admitted only after the satisfactory quality report from 3rd party.
The contractor should follow items and conditions as specified in standard bid document KW-1-4

Successful bidder submitting bids below the amount put to tender will required to submit the difference amount in the form of FDR/DD Pledge (excluding Bank Guarantee) on the name of EE PRED BELLARY within 20 days from the date of receiving the letter of acceptance. Failing which EMD will be forfeited and further action will be taken as per G O No FD PCL 2008 Bangalore Dated 14/10/2008. Cluase 25 of KW-2
The Contractor Should Submit the MDP Receipts for the Material Used for the Work. Otherwise it will attract the Five times fine as per the Mines and Geology Dept
Period Of Completion of Work is 06 Months

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual turnover certificate with valid UDIN No for last 5 years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26 obtained from the Chartered Accountant and supported by the income tax returns filed by the bidder with IT departments.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 a. achieved in at least two financial years on average annual financial turnover b. achieved in at least one financial years on average annual financial turnover for SC/ST Tenderers of 100 percent of cost of the work.

Work done certificate for Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work value not less than 50 percent from Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent b. at least any construction work to an extent of 25 percent of cost of the work for SC/ST/CAT Tenderers in the last five years period i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 And also list of such works in FORMAT-2
Caste certificate and the domicile certificate in the prescribed format Format-D for tenderers claiming reservation for work reserved for SC
Existing commitments and ongoing works which are yet to be completed
The works for which tender acceptance letters are received are to be furnished.
The information of the works for which tenderer has already submitted tender are to be furnished.
The information on litigation in which the Tenderer is involved are to be furnished.
Name, address, and telephone, telex, and fax numbers of the tenderers bankers who may provide references if contacted by the employer are not furnished.

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity A X N X 5 - B

Supply, delivery, installation and commissioning of an All in One Computer with Intel Core i5 13th Generation or higher processor or AMD Ryzen 5 7000 Series processor equivalent or better, either with quad core, base clock speed of 2.0 GHz, cache memory of 6 MB or higher, compatible chipset and OEM motherboard with SoC and TPM 2.0, 16 GB DDR4 RAM at 3200 MHz (1 x 16 GB or 2 x 8 GB) or higher, 1 TB SSD or higher, integrated HD audio with two internal speakers rated at 2 W each, integrated Gigabit Ethernet connection supporting 10/100/1000 Mbps, Wi Fi 802.11ax, and a display monitor of 23.5 inches or higher with Full HD resolution. The system shall include a USB keyboard and a USB 2 button optical scroll mouse of the same make as the computer, a minimum of 4 USB ports including USB 3.0 or higher, one Ethernet RJ 45 port, one HDMI or DP port, a 3.5 mm headphone and microphone combo jack, and an integrated HD webcam with microphone. The OEM shall possess ISO 9001 2015 certification or the latest version. The computer shall be supplied with Windows 11 Home or higher operating system, OpenOffice software application, and the latest version of antivirus software preloaded, such as Symantec, McAfee, NOD32, ESET, Kaspersky, eScan, Quick Heal or K7. All necessary connecting cables and driver media shall be included. The computer shall be covered by a 3 year comprehensive onsite warranty.

Supply of a multifunction laser printer with print, scan and copy functions, feeder and two sided automatic duplex printing, automatic paper sensor, and a print speed of up to 30 pages per minute for A4 size paper. The printer shall have a monthly duty cycle of up to 30,000 pages, one standard paper tray with provision for up to two paper trays, a maximum input capacity of up to 251 sheets, and black print resolution of up to 1,200 x 1,200 dpi. It shall support A4, A5, A5 LEF, B5, Letter, Oficio, envelopes DL and C5, and custom media sizes ranging from 76 x 127 mm to 216 x 356 mm. The printer shall support plain, thick, thin, cotton, coloured, pre printed, recycled, label, cardstock, bond, archive and thicker media, with a supported media weight of 60 to 220 g per square metre. It shall provide a maximum of 99 copies, copy reduction and enlargement from 25 percent to 400 percent, background adjustment, black darkness control, original size selection, duplex copying, ID copy, multiple copies and N up copying. The scanning system shall use Contact Image Sensor technology and support colour scanning, copying through the front panel, scanning through the multifunction printer interface, TWAIN and WSD. It shall support a maximum scan size of 215.9 x 297 mm, 24 bit colour depth, 256 levels of grayscale, TWAIN Version 2.1, JPEG and PDF file formats, and enhanced scanning resolution of up to 600 dpi. The recommended automatic document feeder life specification shall be 20,000 scans per month, with a scanner life specification of 4,000 scans over 60 months. Connectivity shall include Hi Speed USB 2.0, Ethernet 10/100 Base TX and wireless connectivity supporting IEEE 802.11 b/g/n at 2.4 GHz, with wireless printing from mobile phones and tablets. The printer shall use one black toner cartridge and one black imaging drum, with a maximum print resolution of up to 1,200 x 1,200 dpi. It shall have 256 MB shared memory for the printer and scanner, a control panel with three indicator lights for power, Wi Fi and status, and ten buttons for power, Wi Fi, ID copy, undo, navigation, OK, menu, start and cancel. The printer shall be compatible with Windows 11, Windows 10, Windows Server 2016 and 2019, Linux, Android, iOS, macOS 12 Monterey, macOS 13 Ventura and macOS 14 Sonoma. The minimum system requirements shall include a 64 bit Windows 11 system or compatible Windows 10 or Windows Server system, 1 GB RAM, 16 GB available disk space, internet connectivity and USB connectivity. It shall support 1 to 5 users, with typical electricity consumption of 1.195 kWh per week. The power supply shall be built in and support 110 V or 200 V, with power consumption of approximately 445 W during printing, 44 W in ready mode, 0.943 W in sleep mode and 0.1 W when switched off. The supplied software shall include a common installer, V3 print driver with Lite SM and Printer Manager. One USB cable and one USB PC to printer cable shall be included. The printer shall be supplied with a one year limited warranty.
